review.headline: Easy 46-minute ride completed at a genuinely easy effort, as the plan intended.
observations: Ride ran 2760 s (46 min) against a 45 min target, so duration matched the plan.
Average HR 126 (max 134) sits well below the 138-140 easy-run HR of recent weeks, which fits RPE 4 and an easy spin.
Steady pace across every split, with no drift or surges, suggests the effort was controlled throughout.
The ride replaced easy running volume as the plan intended, after the heavy tempo session on Nov 10.
flags: No RPE logged for this ride, so the athlete's own effort rating is missing.
Cadence reads 0 and the pace label is in running units, so the device or import may need checking.
No runs or hand-logged sessions appear after Nov 11, although the plan continues through late November. Training metrics show CTL falling from 44.4 to 31.7.
